attributes.residual: NOT DONE, deliberately, and each is reported to the integrator rather than shipped. (a) THE ROOT CAUSE OF ITEM 4 IS ONE REGEX AND I DID NOT CHANGE IT: fndiff.PRIVATE_DATA_RE is '^\.{3}(?:rodata|data)\.\d+$', so the private-alias mapper that already resolves ...data.N and ...rodata.N does not cover ...bss.N. Widening it would fix the class at the source instead of annotating around it in regnorm, but it moves fndiff `real` project-wide and invalidates every gate baseline in every worktree, which is an integrator decision and outside a tool lane's blast radius. (b) The structure arbiter is unavailable on baselines taken before this run; they say so rather than guessing, but every live baseline needs re-taking to benefit. (c) probe --revert-baseline and --discard remain whole-file; only --revert was scoped, per the work order. (d) regnorm's unpaired count includes relocation annotation lines, so a function at exact instruction parity can still report unpaired rows (DrawPsysSub: T290/O290 exact, 46 unpaired). That is pre-existing and was left alone. (e) add_got_it/init_got_it/kill_got_it carry a genuinely unresolvable reloc row -- target lbl_80275534 vs our got_it, and got_it is absent from symbols.txt -- so no annotation is claimed for them. Leaving them un-annotated is the correct fail-closed outcome, not a gap.
